{"like":["Values high-quality, well-preserved classic films and appreciates detailed, faithful restorations and colorization of older titles.","Highly values iconic casting and performances from early Hollywood stars, especially in sound-era classics.","Enjoys comprehensive collections that include all relevant titles, often with individual discs and thoughtful packaging.","Appreciates films that capture the comedic essence of legendary duos like Laurel & Hardy, and the charm of classic Westerns and war dramas.","Seeks out films that offer a nostalgic, Americana experience with strong storytelling and memorable music scores."],"dislike":["Dislikes poor transfer quality, especially when it results in a beat‑up 16mm look or out-of-focus images.","Criticizes releases that omit titles or fail to provide a complete set, leading to an incomplete viewing experience.","Finds certain actors or characters unappealing, such as Alfalfa or a crummy killer portrayal by Mark Stevens.","Rejects films that lack colorization or have subpar restoration, preferring fully restored, colorized versions.","Dislikes releases that include unrelated or forgettable content, such as unrelated children's films, or that are cheaply produced and not available on DVD.”}​"
 
   ]}
